name: tts-cpp
description: Text-to-speech in pure C++/ggml: Resemble Chatterbox (Turbo + Multilingual), Supertonic, Fun-CosyVoice3, Parler-TTS (CPU + Metal / Vulkan / OpenCL GPU), and LavaSR speech enhancement. Sourced from tetherto/qvac-ext-lib-whisper.cpp (engines/tts). This pin (master HEAD 4456c59b, PR #121) gives CosyVoice3 AND Parler the iOS memory-peak fix: map-in-place weight loading (mmap-backed clean pages) so the CPU model loads fit within the default iOS app memory budget (no OOM on non-entitled devices), plus sequential lazy stage loading for CosyVoice3's ~2.4 GB set; CPU output is byte-identical. It carries PR #119's Parler Vulkan-on-Mali, PR #118's CosyVoice3 GPU path and the ggml-speech 2026-08-03 floor, the dl-safe backend init (PR #117), bounded Parler DAC decode (PR #114), full Parler Vulkan pipeline (PR #110), Metal GPU support (PR #103), and the original CosyVoice3 engine (PR #99).
